# @straightbourne  

I am a writer and researcher based in Scotland, currently completing a PhD at The University of Edinburgh.

---

If we are defined by our career trajectories, mine includes: 

* REME soldier (Avionics)
* Systems Engineer (Flight Simulation)
* Project Manager (Simulation and Defence)
* Solutions Developer (Health and Tourism)
* Teacher (Physics and Mathematics)
* Lecturer (Initial Teacher Education)

You can read more about me and my research at [sptr.net](https://sptr.net).
